_source: Published Nepali patro (Bikram Sambat), month start by month start: Hamro Patro (hamropatro.com/calendar/<year>/<month>), cross-checked against nepcalendar.com, bhitta.app, nepalicalendar.rat32.com and englishtonepali.com/calendar-bs/<year>. Every year below was resolved to its own patro month starts — neighbouring years do NOT share a month-length array (BS 2080, 2084 and 2085 each differ from their neighbours while still tiling the AD calendar).
_contract: This is the ONLY hand-maintained copy of the BS calendar in the repo. The client bundle (client/src/utils/nepaliCalendar.ts), the server defaults (server/src/config/bsCalendar.ts) and the database seeder (scripts/setup_db.js) all read this file, and the UI seed presets derive from it, so a year cannot be corrected in one place and stay stale in another. tests/bsCalendarPatroData.test.ts pins every month start below and refuses any second copy.
